delta_3.reason: The crawling peg change to 1% monthly from 2025-02-01 [MONETARY_01] and the fiscal surplus [FISCAL_01] suggest a deceleration of inflation, although social stress [SOCIAL_01] and the legislative election [POL_01] introduce uncertainty.

evidence.claim: INDEC reported that the December 2024 IPC was 2.7% monthly and accumulated inflation for 2024 was 117.8%.
The BCRA announced that the official crawling peg would move to 1% monthly from 2025-02-01.
The Ministerio de Economía announced a fiscal surplus.
The World Bank projects a rebound for Argentina around 5% in 2025 and 4.7% in 2026.
The BCRA REM December 2024 expects 25.9% inflation in 2025.
Poverty is at 49.9% in 3Q2024 and broader subsistence/privation pressures exist.
